subject: Request: One-time packaging credit for AppSigma strategic bundle
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-08-04T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request: One-time packaging credit for AppSigma strategic bundle

Hi team,

Quick context: AppSigma is a series-B analytics platform, currently evaluating a 3-year enterprise commitment for our Hosted API + Dedicated capacity bundle. They came back with a packaging ask that deviates from our standard tiers: they want a combined seat/throughput package with a larger prefix cache guarantee and 12-month billing in arrears. The economics look promising — ARR under the proposed structure is ~$1.1M year one with predictable expansion potential.

They have asked for a one-time "implementation & packaging" credit to offset migration costs and to make the multi-year TCO competitive with a rival vendor. Proposed ask: a one-time $75,000 credit applied in month 1, plus a 10% entry discount on month 1 invoice. Total estimated concession: $75k credit + ~$11k discounted revenue in month 1.

Why approve?
- Strategic footprint in analytics vertical; strong reference potential and immediate integrations with two cloud partners.
- Upsell motion expected in 12–18 months (model footprint growth expected x2).
- Legal has signoff on standard PO plus amendment; procurement pushed for a single approval rather than multiple redlines.

Risks/controls:
- Ask to gate credit behind a signed SOW and a 60-day onboarding milestone.
- Proposed cap: single one-time credit only; no recurring discounts.

Attachments: pricing-grid-v2.xlsx (detailed scenarios), contract-amendment-draft.docx (amendment with credit line).

Next step: can we get an exception approval from leadership (VP/CFO) to proceed? I can pull numbers into a short memo if helpful.

Thanks,
Ben
Ben Carter
Account Executive — Strategic Sales
Redwood Inference

From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-08-04T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: One-time packaging credit for AppSigma strategic bundle

Ben — thanks for the clear summary and the modeling. I reviewed the attachment and the projected payback looks reasonable provided we lock the onboarding milestone and limit the concession to a single credit.

Marissa, Vivek — flagging this for an executive-level exception: AppSigma is requesting a one-time $75k implementation/packaging credit outside our published packaging table and billing cadence. Ben recommends gating the credit on the signed SOW and milestone completion (60 days).

Ask: Can leadership approve a one-time credit up to $75,000 with the following conditions?
1) Credit applied only after signed SOW and after QA & onboarding milestone completion (60d).
2) No change to ongoing unit pricing; standard upsell motions only.
3) Legal to prepare an amendment that includes recoupment language if the customer terminates before 12 months.

I attached a short approval memo (appsigma-approval-memo.pdf) and the pricing grid. If approved, Ben will proceed to send the amendment and procurement will route the PO.

If you prefer a short 1-page memo for finance/cfo signoff I can draft and tag legal.

—Olga
Olga Petrov
Director, Commercial Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-08-04T15:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: One-time packaging credit for AppSigma strategic bundle

Thanks for the context. I reviewed the numbers and AppSigma looks like a strategically useful reference — I'm inclined to approve with tighter guardrails.

Approval (conditional):
- One-time credit approved: $60,000 (reduced from requested $75k).
- Must be paid back pro rata if the customer does not remain on a billed relationship for at least 9 months (recoupment clause in amendment).
- Credit applied on first invoice only after sign-off of the 60-day onboarding milestone.
- Legal to include explicit milestone acceptance language; Finance to track as deferred revenue until milestone completion.

Marissa — please confirm from a finance/CFO perspective that $60k + the deferred revenue handling is acceptable. If you approve, Olga please finalize the memo and ask Legal to issue the amendment. We should also capture the approval in the deal record (HubSpot).

Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
VP, Sales — Enterprise Accounts
Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-08-04T17:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: One-time packaging credit for AppSigma strategic bundle

Agree to the conditional approval. Finance will accept the $60k one-time credit with the following caveats:
- Legal and Revenue Ops must include the recoupment language and milestone acceptance definition in the amendment (we'll use the 9-month pro rata recoupment Vivek suggested).
- Revenue recognition: treat the credit as a contra-revenue item until milestone acceptance; Finance will monitor onboarding acceptance and mark deferred revenue reversal accordingly.
- Please add a single-line approval record in HubSpot (Deal D-2027-01342-APPSIG) with the approval note and link to the amendment.

Olga — please circulate the final memo (I attached a marked-up version) and loop Legal (legal@redwood.com) + RevOps to create the amendment. Ben — you have signoff to proceed to procurement with the $60k cap under these conditions.

Thanks — Marissa
Marissa Cole
Head of Finance (interim CFO)
Redwood Inference
